instruction: Capture the video frame currently visible in VLC and save it to the Desktop as 'capture.png'.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing video screenshot and saving as 'capture.png' on Desktop. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists, (2) valid PNG, (3) size 10KB-50MB. State-based evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file exists at the exact path specified in instruction (/home/user/Desktop/capture.png)
Getter uses appropriate bash commands (stat, file) to check file existence, size, and PNG format validation
Metric scoring logic is sound with appropriate weights (0.4 for existence, 0.3 for PNG validation, 0.3 for size range)
Size range 10KB-50MB is reasonable for video screenshots and prevents empty/corrupted files
All instruction requirements are covered: save location (Desktop), filename (capture.png), and file type (PNG)
No postconfig needed - file state is persistent and doesn't require UI to remain open
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: Evaluator doesn't verify PNG content is actually from VLC video (could pass with any valid PNG file). However, content-level verification would require advanced image analysis which may be beyond typical evaluator scope.
